name: Compare Instagram posting rates at your venues and competitors with RecentReborn, Google Sheets and Telegram

parameters.content:
## Compare Instagram posting rates at your venues and competitors with RecentReborn, Google Sheets and Telegram

### How it works

This workflow tracks Instagram posting activity for configured venues and competitors by querying RecentReborn, storing samples and post details in Google Sheets, and sending Telegram updates. It supports an initial venue setup path through n8n forms, then runs on a schedule or manually to sample posting rates, append new data, update venue state, and produce weekly comparison reports. When enabled, it uses OpenAI to summarize caption themes before building the Telegram report.

### Setup steps

- Configure the RecentReborn API access used by the HTTP Request nodes for location lookup and post search.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and prepare the target spreadsheet with the expected Venues, Samples, and Posts tabs/columns.
- Create and connect a Telegram bot credential, then set the destination chat ID in the Set Venue Config node.
- Update Set Venue Config with the spreadsheet URL, setup form URL, timezone, Telegram chat ID, and any quota or reporting settings used by the code nodes.
- If AI summaries are desired, configure the OpenAI credential/model connected to the LLM Chain node; otherwise leave the AI summary setting disabled.

### Customization

You can adjust the schedule frequency, request wait time, daily quota thresholds, report cadence, Telegram message wording, and whether weekly reports use AI caption summaries.

## Start and configure

Entry cluster for setup form submissions, scheduled runs, and manual tests. It sets shared configuration and routes execution into either venue setup or normal sampling.

## Venue location lookup

Looks up available venue locations in RecentReborn, transforms the response into selectable choices, and checks whether any results were found.

## Venue selection forms

Presents either the venue selection form when locations are available or a problem form when lookup fails or returns no usable venues.

## Save selected venues

Converts selected venue labels back into RecentReborn location IDs, writes the configured venues to Google Sheets, and confirms the save to the user.

## Load venues and setup

Reads active venues from the spreadsheet, prepares per-venue sample jobs, alerts on read errors, and sends a setup reminder if no usable venue configuration exists.

## Sample loop gate

Iterates over configured venues, prepares each RecentReborn sample request, and skips requests when quota or prior fatal errors require stopping early.

## Fetch and classify posts

Spaces out API calls, fetches posts for the current venue, measures posting rate on success, and records a structured failure marker on request errors.

## Summarize sample results

Runs after the venue loop, builds the single run summary, splits sample rows, and appends the sampled posting-rate records to Google Sheets.

## Restore summary branch

Collapses the per-row Google Sheets output back to the run summary and decides whether any newly discovered posts need to be written.

## Append new posts

Splits new post records, appends them to the Posts tab, and restores the run summary before continuing to venue updates.

## Update venue state

Splits updated venue rows, writes current venue state back to Google Sheets, continues with the run summary, and sends Telegram alerts for sheet write failures.

## Report routing and reads

Checks whether a full report is due, reads historical Samples and Posts logs when needed, and alerts if report source data cannot be read.

## Compute report stats

Builds weekly comparison statistics from the logs and routes the report through the optional AI-summary path or directly to message creation.

## Optional AI summary

Uses an OpenAI chat model through the LLM Chain to summarize caption themes for the weekly report when AI summaries are enabled.

## Build outbound messages

Creates either full weekly report messages or urgent alert-only messages, including fallback handling if the AI output is missing or malformed.

## Send and record

Sends the prepared Telegram messages and records that the weekly report was successfully delivered after Telegram accepts the messages.

parameters.formDescription: Type a venue name (add the city for better matches) and choose whether it is one of your venues or a competitor. On the next page you pick the matching Instagram locations.

See the sticky note below for what each one does.

assignments.name: aiInstructions
assignments.value:
You analyse Instagram captions from posts tagged at venues. Venues in the group "own" belong to us, venues in the group "competitor" do not.
For each venue, name up to 3 short themes people post about (for example: brunch, live music, long queue, rooftop view). Use only what the captions say.
Set tone to positive, mixed, negative or neutral.
In watch_posts, list captions from OWN venues that describe a complaint or a bad experience, using the caption index i, with a short reason. Leave it empty if there are none.
In summary, write 2 to 3 plain sentences on what people post about at our venues compared with the competitors. Do not invent facts.
